items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Billy Douglas was around here for quite a while. [INTERVIEWEE] Red got to be a hellion later...

ctx.x: I went to Texas--we didn't play Arkansas. We jumped from Memphis, Tennessee into Dallas and it broke my heart that we weren't booked in Little Rock. Never played there.
I remember something-- Red used to go out and jam, I guess you probably did, and some local cat blew him out--Billy Douglas was around here for quite a while.
Red got to be a hellion
